user.title: Connect to IthoWiFi add-on
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your IthoWiFi add-on. Authentication is only needed if API security is enabled on the device.

rf_source.title: RF Standalone — Select data source
rf_source.description: The add-on is in RF standalone mode. Select which tracked RF source to use for sensor data.

sensors.title: Select sensors ({device_type})
sensors.description: Choose which sensors and diagnostic items to include. You can change this later in the integration options.

remote_fans.title: RF and Virtual Remote devices ({device_type})
remote_fans.description: Optionally expose each configured RF send remote or virtual remote as its own fan entity, so you can control them individually from Home Assistant. This is in addition to the main fan entity. DemandFlow devices have all configured remotes pre-selected; other device types default to none. You can change this later in the integration options.

data.remote_fans: Remotes to expose as fan entities

remote_sensors.title: Remote sensors ({device_type})
remote_sensors.description: Optionally expose the live data a receive remote reports over RF (CO2, temperature, humidity, last command, ...) as sensors. Each selected remote becomes its own device. Only remotes that have reported data are listed. You can change this later in the integration options.

thermostats.title: Spider thermostats ({device_type})
thermostats.description: The add-on has discovered these Itho Spider room thermostats. Each selected Spider becomes its own device with a climate entity (room temperature, setpoint, heating). You can change this later in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device

init.title: Configure IthoWiFi
init.description: Select which sensors and diagnostic items to include, which RF or virtual remotes to expose as individual fan entities, and which remotes to expose as sensors. Itho Spider thermostats the add-on knows about can be added as climate entities.

confirm.title: Add Itho Spider {rf_id} as thermostat
confirm.description: The IthoWiFi add-on found an Itho Spider room thermostat ({rf_id}). Add it to Home Assistant as a thermostat, so you can see the room temperature and change the setpoint? Choose Ignore on this issue if you don't want it. You can change this later in the integration options.
